title: Luscious Charred Norwegian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and cozy Norwegian dish featuring charred lamb and dried oregano, perfect for a cold winter's night. This high-protein friendly stew is made with fermented ingredients for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced fermented garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the dried oregano, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the lamb broth, tomato paste, carrots, and potatoes to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
